articles.title: President Trump Last Night on Air Force One: Cuba, Mexico, Colombia, Iran and Greenland
articles.summary: A commentary predicts a significant escalation of global conflicts in 2025, labeling it 'Monroe doctrine 2.0'. It forecasts eight wars within 12 months, involving bombings in countries like Iran, Iraq, Nigeria, Palestine, Somalia, Syria, Yemen, and Venezuela, suggesting a period of widespread international instability and military intervention.

articles.title: Army procurement probe: 17 company directors remanded
articles.summary: Seventeen company directors in Kuala Lumpur have been remanded over alleged involvement in a cartel manipulating procurement tenders for the Malaysian Army. This highlights the crucial importance of transparency and integrity in defence acquisition processes globally. For aspiring officers, understanding such challenges underscores the need for robust oversight to maintain the armed forces' readiness and public trust, even beyond national borders.

articles.title: Cambodia violated truce with cross-border ‘accident’ – Thailand
articles.summary: Thailand accused Cambodia of violating a 10-day truce, reporting cross-border mortar fire wounded a soldier. Cambodia denied the violation, claiming a "pile of garbage" exploded, injuring two of its own personnel. This incident highlights persistent border tensions between the two nations despite recent attempts at de-escalation, underscoring the fragility of ceasefires in disputed territories.

articles.title: MediaRadar Launches Data Cloud: Powering AI-Ready Marketing Intelligence, Everywhere
articles.summary: MediaRadar's Data Cloud provides AI-ready Marketing Intelligence, integrating with data warehouses and AI platforms. This technology enables teams to train models and generate insights, streamlining marketing strategies through advanced artificial intelligence. It exemplifies the increasing application of AI in commercial data analysis and decision-making processes, a key area of modern technological advancement.

articles.title: Did ex-Venezuelan spy chief Hugo Carvajal release list of US senators who took kickbacks? What we know
articles.summary: The article presents a hypothetical scenario for January 2026, where United States forces reportedly captured Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores. This fictional event serves as a premise to discuss social media posts. These posts allegedly circulated claims concerning former Venezuelan intelligence chief Hugo Carvajal, underscoring how speculative narratives can spread online, even if based on unverified or fabricated international incidents.

articles.title: GE Aerospace appoints Shilpa Gupta as CTO of India operations
articles.summary: GE Aerospace has appointed Shilpa Gupta as its Chief Technology Officer for GE Aerospace in India and the site leader for the John F Welch Technology Centre (JFWTC) in Bengaluru. This significant appointment highlights the growing leadership roles for Indian professionals in global aerospace and technology sectors, crucial for India's indigenous capabilities and defence innovation.
